_doc: Critical-MCP liveness config read by liveness.py. basic-memory is THE keystone (auto-restart + loud alert on death — the cure for the silent 4h memory loss). re-harness daemons are checked ONLY when registered (registry.json non-empty) so we never nag about IDA/Ghidra being down when not doing RE; they are report-only (restart via re_launch, never auto-killed here).

basic-memory.why: semantic memory vault — durable cross-session/cross-compaction recall+capture

reharness.restart_hint: re_launch.py <tool>  (RE daemons are heavy/context-specific — not auto-restarted)
